# sksplugin — STarKos

**STarKos**, Targhan / Arkos' AY-3-8912 / YM2149 tracker for the **Amstrad CPC**
(the predecessor of Arkos Tracker).

Extensions: `.sks` (plus Arkos Tracker `.aks`)

Playback is via Arkos Tracker 3's own player. The same engine also takes Vortex
Tracker II's rarer ini-style **text** export of `.vt2`; the binary `.vt2` save
goes to [zxayplugin](../zxayplugin/README.md).
